title: City Key Present — payload
description: A City Key (agentprivacy.vta/1) with the packets and chain faces the bearer chooses to give; the response ($defs.Response) is the reader's four-state determination per claim.

key.description: The City Key exactly as exported. Its full shape is owned by agentprivacy.vta/1; members not listed here are carried and folded into κ but not checked by this task.

kappa.description: OPTIONAL. The key's κ as stamped at export. Absent on a working key never exported.

did.description: OPTIONAL. The bearer's did:key, derived from identity.publicKeyHex.

publicKeyHex.description: The ed25519 card public key, 64 lowercase hex.

trustTier.description: OPTIONAL. The tier the key has reached (blade, light, heavy, dragon).

packets.description: OPTIONAL. Root and count over the key's packet proofs.

holds.description: OPTIONAL. Root and count of the Hold kept beside the key; never re-derived by the City.

chains.description: OPTIONAL. Root and count over the chain faces folded into the key.

packets.description: OPTIONAL. The packets the bearer gives so the reader can re-derive packetsRoot. Absent means the packets claims are `absent` or `unavailable`.

items.description: One packet as held by the key; its proof is the hash of its canonical form without proof.

faces.description: OPTIONAL. The chain faces (agentprivacy.chain-faces/1) so the reader can re-derive chains. Absent means the chains claim is `unavailable`.

items.description: One face: public chain roots keyed by lattice vertex.

count.description: How many states the face folds.

states.description: Vertex number to { k: chain root κ }.

Sha256.description: A sha256 digest as `sha256:` and 64 lowercase hex.

RootCount.description: A fold root and the number of items under it.

State.description: match: re-derived and agrees. mismatch: re-derived and disagrees. absent: nothing was claimed. unavailable: claimed, but the material to check it was not given.

Response.description: The reader's determination. ok means nothing contradicted, never a permission.

ok.description: True when no state is mismatch.

did.description: The DID against the public key.

holds.description: The Hold: never re-derived here, so absent or unavailable.

unverified.description: The claims whose state is absent or unavailable: what a consumer must read before showing anything as verified.

participantId.description: OPTIONAL. The participant id derived from identity.publicKeyHex.
